## Objective
- Continue and finish the existing game in the repository as a complete, playable game.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Treated the existing Batman: Shadows of Gotham Three.js project as the game to finish.
- Added Enter/Space keyboard support to advance dialogue, complementing the existing on-screen Continue button.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing game files and confirmed the project already contains a 3D city, story campaign, combat, collectibles, riddles, character swapping, vehicles, touch controls, and replay modes.
- Started a local HTTP server on port 3002 and opened the game in Playwright.
- Captured and inspected screenshots at `/tmp/opencode/gotham-check.jpg`, `/tmp/opencode/gotham-dialogue.jpg`, and `/tmp/opencode/gotham-play.jpg`.
- Modified `game.js` so Enter or Space advances dialogue while dialogue is active.

### Active
- Continue testing the game’s core gameplay flow and fix any issues that prevent completing the campaign.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the latest screenshot `/tmp/opencode/gotham-play.jpg` and current browser state.
2. Test movement, combat, collectibles/riddles, boss progression, and replay flow; patch any blockers.
3. Check `git diff` and summarize the completed game and reasonable assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, story, controls, combat, UI logic; contains the uncommitted dialogue keyboard change.
- `index.html`: Game UI and controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and touch controls.
- `README.md`: Project overview.

## Important Context
- The game is titled “BATMAN: SHADOWS OF GOTHAM”; the main campaign objective chain is gang operation → eight clues → Riddler → Two-Face.
- There is also a villain replay mode, but it does not appear to end when both heroes are defeated; they rally and continue fighting.
- `game.js` imports Three.js from `https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`.
- Browser output included a missing `/favicon.ico` 404 and WebGL performance warnings; no gameplay-breaking module error was observed.
- Changes are uncommitted.

- Finish the existing Batman: Shadows of Gotham project as a complete, playable game.

- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest.

- Continue the existing Three.js game and campaign rather than starting a new project.
- Support Enter/Space dialogue advancement alongside the Continue button.

### Completed
- Inspected the existing game and confirmed it includes a 3D city, campaign, combat, collectibles, riddles, character swapping, vehicles, touch controls, and replay modes.

- Verified Enter advances dialogue through the intro and reaches the playable street-war objective.

- Test the gameplay flow and fix any blockers to completing the campaign.

2. Save and inspect the latest screenshot following the stated viewport and JPEG constraints.

- `game.js`: Three.js scene, story, controls, combat, UI logic, and uncommitted dialogue keyboard change.
- `index.html`: Game UI and controls.

- `README.md`: Project overview.

- Campaign objective chain: gang operation → eight clues → Riddler → Two-Face.
